corporate.label: Corporate Recruiter
corporate.talking_points: Focus on access to diverse, curated candidate pools and DEI metrics. Emphasize long-term career support and retention.

education.label: Educational Institution
education.talking_points: Highlight improved retention, belonging, and career pathways. Showcase leadership development and community building.

nonprofit.label: Nonprofit / Community Organization
nonprofit.talking_points: Emphasize scalable, low-cost solutions that maximize in-person engagement. Focus on measurable outcomes and community reach.
